resources.string: Note that Bing search is crawler-based, which may be unstable and is not recommended.
settings.yml needs to enable json format support:
Custom search provider powered by QuickJS. Implement search(query, resultSize) and optionally scrape(urls) functions. Use fetch(url, options?) for HTTP requests.

SuiXiang search gateway. Configure an API key to search the web. Each search costs a fixed CNY 0.06 (not multiplied by the group rate); failed searches are not charged. The API key from the current group is used. The first search may take 15–60 seconds, and more results take longer.

DeepSeek official search and fetch. Configure a DeepSeek API key to search the web and fetch page content. Billed per successful request at CNY 5 per 1,000 calls (about CNY 0.005 each); failed or empty searches are free. Account-level limit is 5 requests per second. Search returns long summaries written for model consumption; fetching uses the DeepSeek Fetch API and returns Markdown.

AnySearch search gateway. Structured results with good Chinese coverage.
· One search counts as one request, regardless of how many results are returned.
· With an API key: free 1,000 requests per day, 20 requests per second.
· Without a key: anonymous access, rate-limited per IP with a lower quota, and it also draws from the daily free quota.
· Get a key at anysearch.com/console/api-keys.
· Up to 10 results per search. Page content can be fetched separately using Extract.
